  <bpmn:message id="Message_TransmittedData" name="Transmitted data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Rejection" name="Rejection"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Request" name="Transaction data request" sourceRef="Task_INQ_TransmitRequest" targetRef="Start_IP_RequestReceived" messageRef="Message_TransactionDataRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Data" name="Transmitted data" sourceRef="Task_IP_TransmitData" targetRef="Task_INQ_ReceiveData" messageRef="Message_TransmittedData"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Rejection" name="Rejection" sourceRef="Task_IP_SendRejection" targetRef="Task_INQ_ReceiveRejection" messageRef="Message_Rejection"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_INQ" name="INQ process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_INQ" name="Request to be transmitted">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_INQ_Start_Transmit</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_INQ_TransmitRequest" name="Transmit transaction data request" messageRef="Message_TransactionDataRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_INQ_Start_Transmit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_INQ_Transmit_Wait</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_INQ_WaitForAnswer" name="Wait for IP answer">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_INQ_Wait_Data</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_INQ_Wait_Rejection</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_INQ_ReceiveData" name="Receive transmitted data" messageRef="Message_TransmittedData">

    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_Transmit_Wait" sourceRef="Task_INQ_TransmitRequest" targetRef="Gateway_INQ_WaitForAnswer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_Wait_Data" name="Transmitted data" sourceRef="Gateway_INQ_WaitForAnswer" targetRef="Task_INQ_ReceiveData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_Wait_Rejection" name="Rejection" sourceRef="Gateway_INQ_WaitForAnswer" targetRef="Task_INQ_ReceiveRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_Data_End" sourceRef="Task_INQ_ReceiveData" targetRef="End_INQ_DataReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_Rejection_End" sourceRef="Task_INQ_ReceiveRejection" targetRef="End_INQ_Rejected"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_IP" name="IP process" isExecutable="false">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IP_Outcome_Data</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IP_Outcome_Rejection</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_IP_TransmitData" name="Transmit data" messageRef="Message_TransmittedData">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IP_Outcome_Data</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IP_Data_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_IP_SendRejection" name="Send rejection" messageRef="Message_Rejection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IP_Outcome_Rejection</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IP_Rejection_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_IP_DataTransmitted" name="Data transmitted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IP_Data_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_IP_RejectionSent" name="Rejection sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IP_Rejection_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_Start_Check" sourceRef="Start_IP_RequestReceived" targetRef="Task_IP_CheckRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_Check_Outcome" sourceRef="Task_IP_CheckRequest" targetRef="Gateway_IP_ExaminationOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_Outcome_Data" name="Transmission of data" sourceRef="Gateway_IP_ExaminationOutcome" targetRef="Task_IP_TransmitData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_Outcome_Rejection" name="Rejection" sourceRef="Gateway_IP_ExaminationOutcome" targetRef="Task_IP_SendRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_Data_End" sourceRef="Task_IP_TransmitData" targetRef="End_IP_DataTransmitted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_Rejection_End" sourceRef="Task_IP_SendRejection" targetRef="End_IP_RejectionSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
